data.desc: CID HoldCo Inc is a Delaware incorporated company focused on completing a business combination. It functions as a blank check or special purpose acquisition company SPAC established with the purpose of effecting one or more business combinations such as mergers exchanges of stock asset acquisitions stock purchases reorganizations or similar transactions. CID HoldCo was founded on May 20 2021 by Phyllis W Newhouse and maintains its headquarters in Kennesaw Georgia.
